differential.name: HIV‑associated anemia (anemia of chronic disease)
differential.rationale: Low CD4 count is normal but HIV infection can cause mild normocytic anemia even with viral suppression.

differential.name: Iron deficiency anemia
differential.rationale: Anemia in a middle‑aged adult with obesity and possible occult GI blood loss; iron studies not provided but common cause.

differential.name: Zidovudine‑induced anemia (antiretroviral medication effect)
differential.rationale: Zidovudine, if part of the regimen, is a classic cause of macrocytic anemia in HIV patients.

differential.name: Anemia of chronic inflammation secondary to obesity/metabolic syndrome
differential.rationale: Obesity and pre‑diabetes generate low‑grade inflammation that can suppress erythropoiesis.

differential.name: Occult gastrointestinal malignancy (e.g., colon cancer)
differential.rationale: Chronic anemia in a 58‑year‑old warrants evaluation for hidden GI cancer despite normal labs.
